decks.name: rich
decks.why: the hand-written fixture, whose names the pool mostly lacks
decks.yaml:
slug: rich-fixture
name: 'Rich Fixture: Every Shape the Dumper Writes'
status: built
stage: curated
commander:
  - Syr Gwyn, Hero of Ashvale
shared: false
pilot: Mark's wife
commander_art: 0aae2e33-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
companion: Kaheera, the Orphanguard
bracket: 3
archetype: midrange
themes:
  - knights
  - equipment
  - voltron
strategy: 'Suit up a knight and swing: Syr Gwyn''s trigger draws a card and the equipment costs nothing,
  so every turn after the third is a cantrip with a sword attached -- panache *and* martial prowess.'
notes:
  mulligan: 'Keep any seven with two lands and an equipment; ship a hand

    with no knight by turn three.'
  politics: 'The table forgets Ashvale until it is too late: say nothing.'
  weird: 'colon: and # hash, plus braces {G}{W} and a trailing space '
cards:
  - name: Sol Ring
    category: ramp
    why: 'Two mana on turn one, and it always has been: the single most played card in the format, the
      first thing every primer tells a newcomer to find, and the card this line exists to make room for
      -- which is why it is first.'
  - name: Embercleave
    category: equipment
    why: 'It''s the card with the apostrophe -- and the one that ends games: flash, trample, double strike.'
    scryfall_id: c3a4b2d1-1111-4222-8333-444455556666
    tags:
      - finisher
      - flash
  - name: Æther Vial
    category: utility
    why: 'Unicode in the name: Æ — é — ü.'
    mana_cost: '{1}'
    art: deadbeef-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
  - name: Forest
    category: land
    why: '* starts with a star, which must be quoted'
    qty: 12
  - name: Plains
    category: land
    why: '#not a comment'
    qty: 13
  - name: Lightning Greaves
    category: equipment
    why: 'yes'
  - name: Null Rod
    category: hate
    why: 'null'
  - name: Counterspell
    category: interaction
    why: '12'
  - name: Swords to Plowshares
    category: interaction
    why: 1.5 mana, in effect
  - name: Knight of the White Orchid
    category: ramp
    why: cost {1}{W}{W} -- braces again, inside a longer sentence that also runs past the hundred-character
      fold so both rules fire at once.
    mana_cost: '{1}{W}{W}'
swap_board:
  - name: Sword of Feast and Famine
    category: equipment
    why: Waiting on a slot.
graveyard:
  - name: Gilded Lotus
    category: ramp
    why: 'Entombed: too slow for a deck that wants its mana on turn two.'
